Definition: probably contracted from a poetic form of G2203 and G1435; Jove-given; Zenas, a Christian:--Zenas.
BiblicalUsage: Zenas the lawyer is named once, when Paul asks Titus to send him and Apollos on their journey with everything they need. He is a Christian worker on the move, and Paul's care for his travel shows how the early church looked after its own. His full story lives on his People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the church runs on people like Zenas: faithful workers whose names we know mostly because someone made sure they were sent well.
